about_short_description.short_description: Mito is a cloud-based platform that provides python data analysis services.

product.name: Mito Spreadsheet Editor
product.description: A spreadsheet interface integrated into Jupyter that allows users to edit data visually and automatically generates equivalent Python code for each edit.

product.name: Mito AI Chat
product.description: An AI-powered chat interface integrated into Jupyter that assists users by generating Python code and providing explanations for data analysis tasks.

product.name: Smart Debugging
product.description: A feature that helps users identify and fix errors in their Python code with explanations provided by AI.

product.name: Code Completions
product.description: An autocomplete feature that predicts and completes Python code snippets to help users write code faster and with fewer errors.

product.name: Snowflake Query Builder
product.description: A no-code SQL query builder integrated with Mito that allows users to generate SQL queries for Snowflake databases without writing code.

product.name: Streamlit and Dash Integration
product.description: Components that allow users to convert Python scripts generated by Mito into interactive dashboards using Streamlit and Dash frameworks.
